changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.sql: UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = "SELECT c.account_no as 'Client Account No.', c.display_name AS 'Client Name', ml.account_no AS 'Loan Account No.', mpl.name AS 'Product Name', lrr.reschedule_from_date AS 'Reschedule From Date', lrr.reschedule_from_installment AS 'Reschedule From Installment', ml.disbursedon_date AS 'Disbursed Date', lrr.submitted_on_date AS 'Requested On', lrr.approved_on_date AS 'Approved On', ml.principal_amount as 'Loan Amount', ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code) as Currency, lrr.reschedule_reason_comment AS 'Comments', rcv.code_value AS 'Reschedule Reason', concat(ms.username,'- ', ms.firstname,' ',ms.lastname) AS 'Loan Officer Name', concat(ma.username,'- ', ma.firstname,' ',ma.lastname) AS 'Approved By', concat(repeat('..', ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as 'Office/Branch' FROM m_office o JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.hierarchy like concat(o.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy like CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') JOIN m_client c ON c.office_id = ounder.id JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.client_id = c.id JOIN m_product_loan mpl ON mpl.id=ml.product_id JOIN m_loan_reschedule_request lrr ON lrr.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN m_appuser ms ON ms.id=lrr.submitted_by_user_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser ma ON ma.id=lrr.approved_by_user_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value rcv ON rcv.id = lrr.reschedule_reason_cv_id LEFT JOIN m_currency cur on cur.code = ml.currency_code WHERE lrr.status_enum = 200 AND o.id=${officeId} AND (mpl.id=${loanProductId} OR ${loanProductId}=-1) AND lrr.submitted_on_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}' AND (ml.currency_code = '${currencyId}' or '-1' = '${currencyId}') ORDER BY ounder.hierarchy, ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code), ml.account_no" WHERE report_name = "Rescheduled Loans";
